summary: Recent changes in the Media Sink area of Firefox focus on improving the audio experience during video playback, especially when users seek to different parts of a video. The updates allow the browser to **reuse the audio stream during a seek**, rather than recreating it from scratch, which can make transitions smoother and reduce potential disruptions. Additionally, the process for handling audio on macOS has been optimized to start asynchronously when resuming playback, further enhancing performance. These improvements are crucial for providing a more seamless and enjoyable multimedia experience for users._
